scope: Actual F1533 bounds/flags initialization and F879 two-pass placement through actual F574/F575/F576/F579/F582/F581/F1876, plus standalone F574 queries with an original model84 zero-inner-bound probe. Nonplayer zero-velocity source objects, all17 natural models and original terrain/contact normalization branches; damage/render branches abort. Model117 is non-spherical and its syntheticcontact cases do not imply a spherical provider. No synthetic height callback or universal SI surface-radius claim.
